title: Geologic Map of the Edgefield Quadrangle, Edgefield County, South Carolina
citation: Morrow, R.H., IV, and Willoughby, R.H., 2023, Geologic Map of the Edgefield Quadrangle, Edgefield County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-246, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Map sheet, OCR text. Units recorded from the description of map units; map symbols taken from the parenthesised symbols in the descriptions (OCR margin labels such as 'Zptt2', 'Zpitt', 'Zpfil', 'C2nbs', 'PPimg' are misreads of Zpft2, Zpft1, Zpft1, CZmbs, PPjmg). Strike and dip numbers on the map face are not legible in the OCR and were not recorded; legend-only symbols (contact and fault line types, foliation symbols, well-log and geochronology point symbols) not recorded. Cross section A-A' read from page-image tiles: unit labels in order from A to A' (Cr with Crt bodies, Zpft2, Zpft1, CZton, Ces, PPjmg, CZpgn, CZmbs, PPeg); the Modoc Shear Zone bracket spans PPjmg to CZmbs. Axis ticks 430 ft (A end) and 650 ft (A' end), sea level, and 2,000 ft below; no distances printed, so no contacts recorded. Coastal Plain units are not depicted on the section. SUBSURFACE: section shows units to about 2,000 ft below sea level; no unit tops or bases with values.
